name: Watashi no Maryoku wa Futago no Otouto no Mono!
original_name: 私の魔力は双子の弟のモノ!
source:
Milia is fighting monsters together with her younger twin brother Sonya.
She is supporting him from behind while he fights with a pair of water swords.
It seems they are in the middle of a journey.
But what is the destination?
